pattern: filter, derive a comparable percentage, rank
question: 2023 only show full immunisation percent district wise highest first
gold_sql: SELECT district, ROUND(100.0 * children_fully_immunised / children_due, 1) AS coverage_percent FROM immunisation WHERE year = 2023 ORDER BY coverage_percent DESC, district
sql_duckdb: WITH immunisation_2023 AS (SELECT district, children_fully_immunised, children_due, CASE WHEN children_due = 0 THEN NULL ELSE (children_fully_immunised * 100.0 / NULLIF(children_due, 0)) END AS full_immunisation_percent FROM immunisation WHERE year = 2023) SELECT district, full_immunisation_percent FROM immunisation_2023 WHERE NOT full_immunisation_percent IS NULL ORDER BY full_immunisation_percent DESC

CURRENT QUESTION:
2023 only show full immunisation percent district wise highest first
attempts.response:
WITH immunisation_2023 AS (
  SELECT 
    district,
    children_fully_immunised,
    children_due,
    CASE 
      WHEN children_due = 0 THEN NULL 
      ELSE (children_fully_immunised * 100.0 / children_due) 
    END AS full_immunisation_percent
  FROM immunisation
  WHERE year = 2023
)
SELECT 
  district,
  full_immunisation_percent
FROM immunisation_2023
WHERE full_immunisation_percent IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY full_immunisation_percent DESC;
